explanation: The trace of a square matrix is equal to the sum of its eigenvalues. $\text{Trace}(M) = \lambda_1 + \lambda_2 = 1 + 6 = 7$.
$P \lor \neg P$ is always true (Law of Excluded Middle). $P \implies P$ and $P \iff P$ are also trivial tautologies. $P \land \neg P$ is a contradiction (always false).
